notes: Lyrics read like a lyric sheet now: the line being sung is the bright one and the lines already sung step back, so the eye finds the words instead of hunting for a highlight.

The lyric highlight follows what is actually sounding. With the music video open the song is paused underneath the picture, so the sheet used to freeze on its last line while the film sang on - it follows the picture now.
A lyric sheet that writes a repeated chorus once with two timestamps keeps both takes, and a sheet with its own offset tag has that offset applied instead of ignored.
The music video opens on FULL HD and never walks down the sizes. If this phone refuses 1080p the picture stays at 1080p and says so, and the size list is where a smaller one can be picked.
With a Gemini key set, HD+ is tuned to each film: one frame is read and the amount of edge and correction comes from it, and the switch reads HD+ AI.
The headphones and the lock screen play and pause the music video when its tab is open, instead of pressing a song that is paused underneath it.
